scope: Reviewed notification source claims only; not full corpus reconciliation.

rows.conflict: Saved and Done retention differs durable conversation/evidence custody.
rows.requirement: Store authorized event identity, timestamp, revision and independently evaluated acceptance separately from notification read/Done/Saved states; preserve retention limits.
rows.negative_test: Done cannot certify task acceptance; unsaved old notification cannot be assumed recoverable after disappearance.

rows.conflict: Tutorial includes Done in is:read; inbox guide excludes it.
rows.requirement: Retain both claims and exact product/version; independent scoped observation required before binding query semantics.
rows.negative_test: Do not certify complete Done inventory from is:read or suppress contrary source claim.

rows.conflict: Shared fragment demands Email plus platform settings while page describes independent email opt-out/platform updates.
rows.requirement: Represent channel preferences independently and mark disputed necessity unknown until observed exact platform/version behavior.
rows.negative_test: Disabled email cannot automatically imply missing web inbox without substantiated condition; enabled email alone cannot imply inbox.

rows.conflict: Default triggers and contextual unsubscribe/custom watch reactivation lists differ.
rows.requirement: Parameterize subscription origin, transition, event, mention/team/review/participation scope and product version; preserve unwatch versus ignore distinction.
rows.negative_test: Unsubscribe or custom event selection cannot certify permanent silence or exhaustive absence of reactivation.

rows.conflict: Selected inbox operations and owner-scoped unwatch differ full estate inventory.
rows.requirement: Preview actual selected IDs/owner/operation with permission checks and explicit change approval; retain full denominator outside visible results.
rows.negative_test: Filtered page or ten-thousand watch ceiling cannot certify complete target coverage; Unwatch all cannot mutate unapproved owner.

rows.conflict: Reply-to identifies account/thread and posting is a write; sanitation is partial.
rows.requirement: Protect reply identity, validate destination and authorized content before posting, preview redacted diff and verify resulting comment without assuming complete sanitation.
rows.negative_test: Email read authority cannot authorize comment posting; signatures, attachments or secret content cannot be assumed safely scrubbed.

rows.conflict: Read synchronization requires image loading; GHES outbound email and background fetch affect delivery.
rows.requirement: Track client image policy, outbound capability, recipient/event/time and actual freshness; distinguish notification read from human review.
rows.negative_test: Image blocking cannot pass sync; configured push cannot prove immediate delivery or accepted review.

limitations: Negative tests are proposed specifications, not implemented/executed bindings.
Conflicts require independent versioned behavior evidence before resolution.
No policy acceptance, rights clearance, subscription changes or native activation.
